# iosxe_voice_trunk_group (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Trunk Group configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_trunk_group" "example" {
  name = "PRI-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Trunk group label

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `hunt_scheme_method` (String) hunt scheme method
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `max_retry` (Number) Maximum number of outgoing call attempts
- `translation_profile_incoming` (String) Translation Profile for incoming call leg
- `translation_profile_outgoing` (String) Translation Profile for outgoing call leg
